[[Cheyenne, Wyoming]], [[United States|USA]] |attendance= |previousevent= |followingevent= }} '''''BKFC 1: The Beginning''''' was a [[bare-knuckle fighting]] event held by Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship on June 2, 2018, at the [[Cheyenne Ice and Events Center]] in [[Cheyenne, Wyoming]], [[United States|USA]]. ===Background=== This was the first bare-knuckle boxing event by Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship (BKFC) and the first sanctioned bare-knuckle boxing event in the United States since 1889.{{cite web |url=https://mymmanews.com/watch-bare-knuckle-fighting-championship/|title=Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship – The Beginning|date=June 2018 |publisher=mymmanews.com}}{{cite web Wyoming|publisher=usatoday.com}} This event featured the quarter-final of a 8-Man Heavyweight Tournament.{{cite web |url=https://www.mmaweekly.com/bare-knuckle-fighting-championship-to-feature-several-former-ufc-fighters|title=Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship to Feature Several Former UFC The event also featured the quarter-final of a 8-Man Lightweight Tournament.{{cite web |url=https://mmasucka.com/2018/10/20/bare-knuckle-fc-3-the-takeover-results/|title=Bare Knuckle FC 3: The Takeover |date=20 October 2018 |publisher=mmasucka.com}} A planned [[Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship#Lightweight Championship|Lightweight Tournament Quarter-Final]] matchup between Reggie Barnett Jr and Josue Rivera was cancelled when Rivera no-showed the event causing Barnett Jr to advance to the semi-finals due to forfeit.{{cn|date=May 2021}} ===Results=== {| class="wikitable" style="font-size: 80%;" |- !
